args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

The function's contract says banker's rounding (FIN-212) but it was
implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail
(2.665 must round to 2.66, not 2.67).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build to fail: `tests/test_money.py` expects `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`, but ROUND_HALF_UP produces `2.67`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented contract.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd59` (branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`): **passed**, including the failing banker's rounding test.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
